name: Dia
source:
Ruby's mentor and an eternal cutie.

A mahou shoujo who taught Ruby magic in another world. She came to this world in search of Ruby, who had gone missing.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/mahou/index.html#CHARACTER]official website[/url]]
